claims.claim: Primary executable is BarTend.exe located at D:\BarTender\BarTend.exe with file size 20,774,984 bytes
claims.evidence_source: D:\BarTender\BarTend.exe filesystem metadata and Authenticode table end offset
claims.reconciled_notes: Confirmed exactly matching on disk.

claims.claim: BarTend.exe file hashes: MD5=7af37ab384391fcc03935a569d705aa0, SHA1=7a57fefa26e99ddec6a46625a8cc17c5a87593aa, SHA256=d3498925149b91c646351e91638906ca4455b2a4cd8db82775bb6860d67d8594
claims.evidence_source: Static cryptographic digests of D:\BarTender\BarTend.exe
claims.reconciled_notes: Report 11 erroneously recorded stale draft MD5 7d73010b91dcfaec676bb062bf6a20bc and SHA1 4633e9ec2d8150eafe0ee994c6ca9c2bf41e39eb. Fully corrected to ground truth.

claims.claim: BarTend.exe FileVersion is 11.4.238.365 and ProductVersion is 11.4.0.1 (BarTender 11.4)
claims.evidence_source: PE VersionInfo resource StringTable and VS_FIXEDFILEINFO
claims.reconciled_notes: Verified against binary resource table.

claims.claim: Target architecture is x86_64 (Machine 0x8664, PE32+ Optional Header, Subsystem 2 GUI)
claims.evidence_source: IMAGE_NT_HEADERS64.FileHeader and OptionalHeader inspection
claims.reconciled_notes: Consistent across all evidence.

claims.claim: Address of Entry Point is 0x97d0fb and ImageBase is 0x140000000
claims.evidence_source: PE OptionalHeader fields AddressOfEntryPoint and ImageBase
claims.reconciled_notes: Report 11 erroneously cited 0x6f3e1c. Corrected to 0x97d0fb.

claims.claim: Section table contains exactly 7 sections: .text, .nep, .rdata, .data, .pdata, .rsrc, .reloc
claims.evidence_source: IMAGE_SECTION_HEADER table at PE offset 0x308
claims.reconciled_notes: Report 11 claimed .tls was present and omitted .nep. In reality, .nep (Native Entry Point) is present and .tls is absent.

claims.claim: Authenticode security directory is at file offset 0x13cb000 with length 20,552 bytes, ending exactly at byte 20,774,984
claims.evidence_source: IMAGE_DIRECTORY_ENTRY_SECURITY at OptionalHeader offset + 144
claims.reconciled_notes: Report 11 erroneously cited offset 0x13c7200 and size 9,472. Corrected to 0x13cb000 and 20,552 bytes.

claims.claim: BarTend.exe is a C++/CLI mixed-mode assembly (COMIMAGE_FLAGS_ILONLY=0, CLR v4.0.30319)
claims.evidence_source: IMAGE_COR20_HEADER at RVA 0xae9b90, Flags=0, EntryPointToken=0x06002c63
claims.reconciled_notes: Proves unmanaged native x64 and managed CIL coexist in the same executable.

claims.claim: Top-level installation directory D:\BarTender contains 589 filesystem items: 555 files and 34 directories
claims.evidence_source: Filesystem enumeration of D:\BarTender\
claims.reconciled_notes: Reconciles prior confusion where 589 was described as "Total Files". Exactly 555 files + 34 subdirectories = 589 items.

claims.claim: Files breakdown into mutually exclusive categories: 24 .exe, 433 .dll, 4 .ocx, 29 .config, 40 .xml, 10 .xsd, 7 .pdf, 3 .ini, 2 .manifest, 3 other (.dat, .ico, .stk) = 555 files
claims.evidence_source: Extension and header audit of all 555 top-level files
claims.reconciled_notes: Sum matches 555 exactly with zero overlap.

claims.claim: The 461 PE binaries classify into: 332 Managed IL-Only, 20 Mixed-Mode C++/CLI, 27 Native x64, 82 Native x86
claims.evidence_source: COM descriptor and machine architecture parsing of 461 binaries
claims.reconciled_notes: Reconciles previous 331 managed / 102 native split. The 82 native x86 DLLs are satellite localized resources and legacy components.

claims.claim: BarTend.exe statically imports 48 DLLs directly via PE Import Table
claims.evidence_source: PE Import Directory table at RVA 0x10d37e8
claims.reconciled_notes: Verified through PE parsing.

claims.claim: BarTend.exe delay-loads 17 DLLs via Delay Import Directory
claims.evidence_source: PE Delay Import Directory table at RVA 0x10d0be0
claims.reconciled_notes: Verified through PE parsing.

claims.claim: Codejock GUI library is ToolkitPro1531vc142x64U.dll (10,844,184 bytes), not XtremeToolkitPro.dll
claims.evidence_source: PE Import descriptor of BarTend.exe and filesystem check of D:\BarTender
claims.reconciled_notes: XtremeToolkitPro.dll was a placeholder name; actual module verified.

claims.claim: Hypothetical DLLs BtEngine.dll, BtBarcode.dll, BtPrint.dll, BtSystem.dll, BtLic.dll, BtData.dll do not exist on disk
claims.evidence_source: Direct filesystem verification across target directory
claims.reconciled_notes: Prior reports hypothesized separate DLLs for these roles. Corrected to show that core engine resides in BarTend.exe and modular Seagull.* / BarCode_* DLLs.

claims.claim: Modular 2D barcode engines are separate native x64 DLLs (BarCode_QRCode.dll, BarCode_DataMatrix.dll, BarCode_Aztec.dll, BarCode_DotCode.dll, etc.)
claims.evidence_source: Export tables of BarCode_*.dll series in D:\BarTender
claims.reconciled_notes: Direct verification of exports: GenerateQRCode, GetQRCell, get_dm_cell, etc.

claims.claim: MFC CArchive and CObList are utilized for document object management and .btw serialization
claims.evidence_source: REA inspect_managed_native_boundaries extracted P/Invoke and CRT symbols
claims.reconciled_notes: Cross-verified with MFC runtime linkage mfc140u.dll and MFCM140U.dll.

claims.claim: Deep function-level native decompilation via Ghidra was NOT_PERFORMED because Ghidra was not installed on host
claims.evidence_source: Environment audit (GHIDRA_INSTALL_DIR unset)
claims.reconciled_notes: All native claims are strictly scoped to static PE headers, export tables, and boundary analysis. Any prior implication of Ghidra decompilation is corrected.

claims.claim: 83 extracted CHM help documentation screenshots and UI icons are copyrighted proprietary assets of Seagull Scientific, LLC and cannot be bundled with Label-Forge
claims.evidence_source: resource_inventory.json and copyright audit of Help/BarTender.chm
claims.reconciled_notes: Clean-room compliance mandate: Label-Forge must use original vector icons and independent UI assets.

claims.claim: BarTender utilizes integer twips (1/1440 inch = 0.01764 mm) with +/-8.8 um quantization; Label-Forge uses double-precision canonical millimeters (Length struct) for continuous float precision
claims.evidence_source: Mathematical analysis of GDI MulDiv twip conversions and Label-Forge Length.cs implementation
claims.reconciled_notes: Rationale clarified: metric standardization, continuous floating-point transformation without cumulative rounding drift, and clean conversion to any DPI.

claims.claim: Printing architecture supports dual pathways: Windows GDI/XPS spooler rendering and direct thermal printer language pass-through
claims.evidence_source: winspool.drv direct imports (OpenPrinter, StartDocPrinter, WritePrinter) and Seagull.BarTender.Print.dll
claims.reconciled_notes: Verified via spooler API imports.

claims.claim: Licensing validation is performed against Seagull License Server (SLS) via Seagull.License.dll and Seagull.Services.Licensing.dll
claims.evidence_source: Managed assembly inspection of Seagull.License.dll and WCF service contracts
claims.reconciled_notes: Verified statically. Clean-room Label-Forge will implement an independent permissive licensing model.
